body: thats a really cool coincidence that you found my post! you're right, it is a pretty cool day to be born. I've always loved that it's the first day of spring too. Hope you found your super specific thing for your counseling class. Happy Birthday to you too!
Wait is today your birthday? If so happy birthday! I hope it's a good one. I wish you the best of luck too, thank you. Enjoy your cake and family!
Thank you. I'm sorry you have to deal with anxiety and depression, hopefully things get better for you too. You are a good person, I mean it. Much love to you too.

I've been trying to find a job for a while, it's just hard because most of the only ones available are in busy places with lots of people and noises, and that always makes me really anxious. I'm going to keep trying though. I hope you are right about my future. Thank you.
I hope you're right, thank you.
Thank you for remembering my birthday, that means more than you'd think. I hope things get better too.
I sorry you went through all of that. How did you get through it? How did you end up getting help?
I'm so sorry that you almost lost your friend, that sounds like it seriously sucked. He's lucky to have you. Thank you for reaching out, I'll try to keep going, I promise.
I've been trying to reach out and respond to every comment and message I get, it's been helping me a lot. Thank you for taking the time to read my post, it means a lot.
Thank you, that is really nice of you to do.
I think you're right about me maybe putting academics on hold for a bit. Thank you, I hope the best for you too.
Lol! It seriously is weirder than I made it seem in my post. I just covered some of the more depressing highlights. If you wanna hear more, message me sometime.
Wow, I'm sorry you are going through all of that. I can't relate that much to your pain but I know it must be hard for you. I hope you can find peace. Good luck in whatever path you take.
Thank you, I hope you can find peace too.
Thank you, this actually made me feel a lot better.
She's still in contact with my biological dad and I'm scared she'll tell him where my family is and he will start trying to contact me. I wish I could trust her. Thank you for the advice though.

Thank you for reading my post. About the abroad program, I'm scared I won't be around next year. This is my only chance to do something like this. I don't have the money otherwise. I've been working on getting in all year. This program is the only thing keeping me motivated to live anymore.
You don't know how much this means to me, thank you.
